references.text: Pedael is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the distribution of the land, and here in Numbers 1:15 another leader of Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan, is named for the census. Both texts concern tribal leaders of Naphtali.
Here Nakbi son of Vofsi is mentioned as a representative of the tribe of Naphtali among the spies. Both verses deal with selected leaders from the tribe of Naphtali for special missions.
These verses introduce the list of chiefs who were to distribute the land, where Pedael from Naphtali (v. 28) is part of this group appointed by the Lord.
Here the actual inheritance that the tribe of Naphtali received is described, as a fulfillment of what Pedael, as chief, was to help distribute.
